name: Suspicious Electron Application Child Processes
description: Detects suspicious child processes of electron apps (teams, discord, slack, etc.). This could be a potential sign of ".asar" file tampering (See reference section for more information) or binary execution proxy through specific CLI arguments (see related rule)
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.parent.executable:(*\\chrome.exe OR *\\discord.exe OR *\\GitHubDesktop.exe OR *\\keybase.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\msedgewebview2.exe OR *\\msteams.exe OR *\\slack.exe OR *\\teams.exe)) AND ((process.executable:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\wscript.exe)) OR (process.executable:(*\:\\ProgramData\\* OR *\:\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\*))) AND (NOT (process.parent.executable:*\\Discord.exe AND process.executable:*\\cmd.exe AND process.command_line:*\\NVSMI\\nvidia\-smi.exe*))
